    PretorsionImageClosed.Statement.isPretorsionTheory_of_realization

    The realization criterion #

    Lemma 3.7 of the manuscript: let T be quotient-closed, F subobject-closed and Z = T ∩ F. If F = {Y : t_T(Y) ∈ Z} and T consists exactly of the objects all of whose morphisms to objects of F are Z-trivial, then (T, F) is a pretorsion theory. It is used to construct meets with a prescribed intersection and to realize image-closed subcategories (Theorem 4.4).

    The proof follows the manuscript with K = r_F(t(X)) in place of r_Z(t(X)): both are the kernel of the trace against F, since Z ⊆ F and morphisms from t(X) to F factor through Z.
